review_locator: PMCID:PMC3657121, Recent advances in understanding the molecular mechanisms of the development and function of Th17 cells; PMCID:PMC4500956, Regulation of IL-17 in autoimmune diseases by transcriptional factors and microRNAs
primary_title: The Th17 immune response is controlled by the Rel-RORgamma-RORgammaT transcriptional axis
decision_basis: The reviews identify c-Rel as an NF-kappaB factor that initiates Rorc expression; the cited primary demonstrates c-Rel binding and activation of the Rorg/Rorc promoter controlling the RORgammaT isoform, with c-Rel deficiency reducing RORgammaT and Th17 expression.
limitations_preserved: Direct promoter binding/activation supports a bounded c-Rel-to-RORC gene bridge; the study distinguishes RORgammaT and RORgamma promoter usage, so no isoform collapse, SCI transfer, or terminal-TF inference is made.
